method: All 34 Map.zip and 44 Map 2.zip reference frames reviewed as overlapping districts. Named roads, landmarks, compass direction and scale bars were checked against existing OSM routes and Overture footprints. Blind template/feature matches were rejected when the district or scale disagreed. Google screenshot pixels, traced geometry and images are not bundled or published.
unchanged: Retain original OSM route topology, real building footprints, other campus data and previously corrected bank-axis and sports points.
limitations: All three places have no surveyed entrance; verified_at remains null.
GST is a reported approximate cluster location, not a new surveyed polygon.
These corrections do not certify every campus room, building entrance or walking path.
